beats.text: Algeria has 100% clean cooking access, the world's highest. South Sudan has 0%.
India has 81%. Under WHO guidelines, kerosene is excluded from clean cooking fuels.
USA has 100%. Across the Atlantic, Nigeria has 28%.
China has 90%, close to the global median of 93%.
At the very bottom, Mali has 2%, Liberia has 1%, and Burundi has 0%.
Brazil has 98%, where nearly everyone cooks with clean fuels.
